attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: config-driven-conditional-execution

steps:
  - id: read_job_configuration
    op: config/read
    params:
      source: job_config_store
      refresh: true
    output: job_config

  - id: apply_configuration_rule
    op: rule/evaluate
    params:
      rule_definition: "{{ job_config.rule }}"
      input_data: "{{ trigger.input }}"
    output: rule_result

  - id: route_execution
    op: branch/conditional
    params:
      condition_value: "{{ rule_result.selected_branch }}"
      branches:
        branch_a:
          - id: execute_branch_a
            op: action/execute
            params:
              action: "{{ job_config.branches.branch_a.action }}"
              parameters: "{{ job_config.branches.branch_a.parameters }}"
            output: branch_a_result
        branch_b:
          - id: execute_branch_b
            op: action/execute
            params:
              action: "{{ job_config.branches.branch_b.action }}"
              parameters: "{{ job_config.branches.branch_b.parameters }}"
            output: branch_b_result
        default:
          - id: execute_default_branch
            op: action/execute
            params:
              action: "{{ job_config.branches.default.action }}"
              parameters: "{{ job_config.branches.default.parameters }}"
            output: default_branch_result
    output: execution_result
